sentinel_issue: The room-count quota appears unenforced: 50,657 rooms were recorded on 2026-09-03 and 46,522 on 2026-10-05, versus the reference’s 5,120-room cap—roughly 9–10× higher. worker_response: The series is not measuring the reference deployment: rooms_capacity changes from 20,480 to 81,920, 163,840, and 250,000, while rooms_total plateaus at 50,657 then falls to 46,522, indicating a scaled/variant namespace or telemetry capacity rather than a fixed 5,120 persisted-room quota. Fix the ambiguity by exporting the effective MAX_ROOMS and counting validated room files separately, then enforce a single atomic 5,120 limit at creation (with idle reaping); otherwise 46,522 rooms remain a real namespace-exhaustion risk even though only the busiest rooms approach the 10 MiB ring.
auditor_verdict: AGREE. The data supports a non-reference or variant deployment: rooms_capacity varies from 20,480 to 250,000, while rooms_total reaches 50,657 and later 46,522 (9.1–9.9× the 5,120 cap), but it does not prove rooms_total is non-persisted telemetry; exporting effective MAX_ROOMS and separately validating room files is necessary, and the observed counts remain an exhaustion risk.
